generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 achieved in at least one financial year a minimum financial turnover in all classes of civil engineering construction works only of Rs 0.20 Lakhs

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2026-27 mandating satisfactory completed as a prime contractor for atleast one similar nature of work to an extent of Rs 0.10Lakhs

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs .0.06Lakhs in the form of Credit lines or Letters of Credit or Certificates from Banks for meeting the fund requirement (Conditional bankers certificate not acceptable)
